title: Divisibility by 2
description: A number is divisible by 2 if its last digit is even.

example.question: Is 428 divisible by 2?
example.solution: The last digit is 8, so 428 is divisible by 2.

note: Even numbers are always divisible by 2.

title: Divisibility by 3
formula: Sum of digits is divisible by  3
description: A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3.

example.question: Is 534 divisible by 3?
example.solution: 5+3+4=12, which is divisible by 3. Hence 534 is divisible by 3.

note: Only the sum of digits matters.

title: Divisibility by 4
formula: Last two digits are divisible by 4
description: A number is divisible by 4 if the number formed by its last two digits is divisible by 4.

example.question: Is 2316 divisible by 4?
example.solution: Last two digits are 16, which is divisible by 4.

note: Ignore all digits except the last two.

title: Divisibility by 5
description: A number is divisible by 5 if it ends in 0 or 5.

example.question: Is 925 divisible by 5?
example.solution: The last digit is 5, so it is divisible by 5.

note: This is one of the easiest divisibility rules.

title: Divisibility by 6
description: A number is divisible by 6 if it is divisible by both 2 and 3.

example.question: Is 234 divisible by 6?
example.solution: It is even and 2+3+4=9 is divisible by 3. Hence divisible by 6.

title: Divisibility by 8
formula: Last three digits are divisible by 8
description: A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is divisible by 8.

example.question: Is 4120 divisible by 8?
example.solution: 120 is divisible by 8, so the number is divisible by 8.

note: Ignore all digits except the last three.

title: Divisibility by 9
formula: Sum of digits is divisible by 9
description: A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 9.

title: Divisibility by 10
description: A number is divisible by 10 if it ends in 0.

example.question: Is 950 divisible by 10?
example.solution: The last digit is 0, so it is divisible by 10.

note: Every multiple of 10 ends with zero.

title: Divisibility by 11
formula: Difference of alternate digit sums is divisible by 11
description: A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sums of alternate digits is 0 or a multiple of 11.
